# tebibcloud_certificate (Data Source)

Looks up a certificate by ID or by name. A private key is never returned.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Certificate ID.
- `name` (String) Name to look up.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID. Default: the provider's `project`.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description.
- `domain_names` (List of String) The names it covers.
- `fingerprint` (String) SHA-256 fingerprint of the leaf.
- `issuer` (String) Issuing CA.
- `not_after` (String) End of validity.
- `not_before` (String) Start of validity.
- `source` (String) `managed` or `imported`.
- `state` (String) Lifecycle state.
- `status` (String) `pending`, `issued`, `failed` or `revoked`.
- `status_code` (String) Why it isn't issued, as a code.
- `status_reason` (String) The reason in words.
- `tags` (Map of String) Tags.
- `test_certificate` (Boolean) Issued by a CA browsers don't trust.
- `trn` (String) TRN.
- `validation` (String) Managed: `dns` or `http`.
